steps.message: Save a track with waypoints Bendern, Liechtenstein, Balzers, Liechtenstein, Triesen, Liechtenstein in the OsmAnd maps app in the same order as listed.

Execute: adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i osmand; ls -la /sdcard 2>/dev/null | grep -i osmand; ls -la /sdcard/Android/data 2>/dev/null | grep -i osmand; for p in net.osmand.plus net.osmand net.osmand.dev net.osmand.plus.free; do echo ==== $p ====; ls -la /sdcard/Android/data/$p/files 2>/dev/null; ls -la /sdcard/Android/data/$p/files/tracks 2>/dev/null; ls -la /sdcard/Android/data/$p/files/tracks/import 2>/dev/null; done"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i osmand; ls -la /sdcard 2>/dev/null | grep -i osmand; ls -la /sdcard/Android/data 2>/dev/null | grep -i osmand; for p in net.osmand.plus net.osmand net.osmand.dev net.osmand.plus.free; do echo ==== $p ====; ls -la /sdcard/Android/data/$p/files 2>/dev/null; ls -la /sdcard/Android/data/$p/files/tracks 2>/dev/null; ls -la /sdcard/Android/data/$p/files/tracks/import 2>/dev/null; done""

Execute: adb shell "cat > /sdcard/Android/data/net.osmand/files/tracks/liechtenstein_waypoints_track.gpx <<'EOF'
<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>
<gpx version=\"1.1\" creator=\"adb\" xmlns=\"http://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/1\" xmlns:xsi=\"http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance\" xsi:schemaLocation=\"http://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/1 http://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/1/gpx.xsd\">
  <metadata>
    <name>Liechtenstein waypoints track</name>
  </metadata>
  <wpt lat=\"47.2099\" lon=\"9.5016\"><name>Bendern, Liechtenstein</name></wpt>
  <wpt lat=\"47.0649\" lon=\"9.5026\"><name>Balzers, Liechtenstein</name></wpt>
  <wpt lat=\"47.1075\" lon=\"9.5268\"><name>Triesen, Liechtenstein</name></wpt>
  <trk>
    <name>Liechtenstein waypoints track</name>
    <trkseg>
      <trkpt lat=\"47.2099\" lon=\"9.5016\"><name>Bendern, Liechtenstein</name></trkpt>
      <trkpt lat=\"47.0649\" lon=\"9.5026\"><name>Balzers, Liechtenstein</name></trkpt>
      <trkpt lat=\"47.1075\" lon=\"9.5268\"><name>Triesen, Liechtenstein</name></trkpt>
    </trkseg>
  </trk>
</gpx>
EOF
ls -l /sdcard/Android/data/net.osmand/files/tracks/liechtenstein_waypoints_track.gpx; sed -n '1,120p' /sdcard/Android/data/net.osmand/files/tracks/liechtenstein_waypoints_track.gpx"
